grp-01-c2.text: Wolfram MathWorld (Eric W. Weisstein). Dihedral Group D4. Wolfram MathWorld.
grp-01-c2.quote: The dihedral group D4 is one of the two non-Abelian groups of the five groups total of group order 8.
grp-01-c2.claim: The symmetries of a square, 4 rotations and 4 reflections, make 8 elements, and together they're the dihedral group D₄.
